behavior_contracts.AE45/trivia: Own-line comments keep content and attachment at canonical indent; trailing comments stay on their code lines; block comments (incl. nested and multiline) stay verbatim; blank runs between rendered lines survive verbatim; strings render byte-for-byte from tokens (comment-like bytes untouched); CRLF normalizes to LF; output ends with exactly one newline.
behavior_contracts.AE45/canonical: One renderer (Format/FormatTrivia share render()); every emitted line carries its source offset; synthetic layout lines resolve their true keyword line. Empty-argument fixture cases render `=> ...` (verified reparseable; the `=> ...` form predates this task).
behavior_contracts.AE45/cli: canlc format FILE prints to stdout (pure syntax); --write requires an enclosing project, both snapshots clean, fixpoint stability, same-file identity plus unchanged bytes, then atomic temp+rename with mode preserved.
behavior_contracts.AE45/negative: Invalid syntax/semantics, missing project, stale/replaced source, failed validation or unstable output leave the file untouched (exit 1); usage errors exit 2. Misordered arms are preserved textually and still fail check identically; strings never change.
